title: stelis imraei
intro: Stelis imraei, commonly known as the "tree orchid," is a species of orchid native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Stelis imraei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. Research suggests that the plant may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, although further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy.
